name: grain-locked-panels
description: HELD OUT - runs in the bench and must clear the waste bar, but no heuristic or constant may be tuned by looking at it. Oak-veneered ply door and drawer panels, every one grain-locked because the veneer shows on every face. The solver has no rotation to trade with anywhere. Hand-checked layout on usable 2430 x 1210: a tall sheet is one 1200mm row of [tall panel 480 x 5] = 2412; the short sheet is two 596mm rows of [short panel 480 x 5] = 2412. Three sheets, 3.5% waste at a perfect pack.
